_comment: D13-F5 Redis ops for the machine-token ticket/redeem pair (enrollment.py:799-932). Not SQL — Redis commands + payload shapes.
method: Transcribed from the cited lines; key/TTL/payload shapes verbatim. No live Redis.

redeem.read: GETDEL machine_token_ticket:{ticket} (atomic consume). On ANY exception from execute_command: fallback to GET + (DELETE when non-None). Empty/missing blob -> 401 invalid_or_expired_ticket.
redeem.then: User.objects.get(id=payload.user_id) + Workspace.objects.get(id=payload.workspace_id); miss/KeyError -> 410 stale_ticket; _maybe_mint_machine_token(dev_machine=None) in tx; None (already active) -> 409 machine_token_already_active; else 201 {machine_token, host_label, workspace_slug}

ticket.key: machine_token_ticket:{ticket} where ticket = uuid4().hex (32 lowercase hex, no dashes)
ticket.redis_none: client None -> SKIP the write but STILL return 201 (byte-oddity: ticket minted but unredeemable; redeem then 503s on redis_unavailable).
ticket.ttl: EX 60 (response expires_in_secs: 60 mirrors the TTL const)
ticket.write: SET key json.dumps(payload) EX 60 — plain SET, no NX (uuid collision overwrite acceptable)
